name: Dependency Cruiser
description: Public module entry points, public-interface tests, and dependency hygiene
note:
**TYPESCRIPT COMPATIBILITY**

TypeScript 7.0 is unsupported and can cause checks to pass without analyzing TypeScript sources. If your project uses TypeScript 7, upgrade to the verified 7.1.0-beta. Compatible TypeScript 2–6 versions remain supported.

This bundle installs dependency-cruiser, but leaves the TypeScript compiler under your project's control.

**MIGRATION NOTE**

To adopt deep modules, ask your agent:

"Read src/modules/README.md. If it contains a migration TODO, work through it."
